author: John_M

title: It was a three-hour tour...
text: It was a three-hour tour that covered all the major areas. It was bit compressed given everything to see. Our guide could not have been nicer and accommodating. We did have an issue at the beginning of the tour that was no fault of the tour company - we had photocopies of our passports rather than the actual passports, and they were not sufficient at the gate so we had to walk back to the ticket office to take care of it. We missed 20 minutes of the tour, but our guide made sure we caught up with them.
author: Michael_R

title: Great Tour
text: Georgia was a great guide and we really enjoyed this.  Just the right amount of information.  Great value for the money.  You don’t want to do Alhambra without a guide.
